exposure: surgical care bundle application (pre-, during, and post-cesarean section)
cohort: A sample of one hundred women undergoing cesarean section.
finding: The application of a surgical care bundle significantly reduced the risk of post-cesarean wound infection, with 100% of the intervention group achieving healthy wound status after 48 hours compared to 80.0% of the control group.
mod_finding: The surgical care bundle application pre-, during, and post-cesarean section significantly reduces the risk of wound infection following this mode of birth.
